title: PCGS CoinFacts Price Guide
key_finding: Market-driven price ranges for U.S. and world coins tied to certified Sheldon 1-70 grades.
relevance: Primary comparable-sales reference for coin valuations.

title: NGC Coin Price Guide
key_finding: Certified coin values by grade, mintage, and market; supports Sheldon-scale normalization.

title: PSA Population Report
key_finding: Quantified scarcity of trading cards by grade; informs rarity and demand dimensions.
relevance: Authoritative rarity/grade reference for card valuations.

title: Beckett Grading Services Population Report
key_finding: Card population and sub-grade data (centering, corners, edges, surface).
relevance: Alternative population source for trading-card valuations.

title: CGC Cards Population Report
key_finding: Population counts for TCG, sports, and non-sports cards graded by CGC.
relevance: Population reference for modern trading cards and TCGs.

title: Heritage Auctions Prices Realized
key_finding: Realized auction prices across coins, currency, comics, trading cards, and collectibles.
relevance: Market-comparable evidence for multiple collectibles categories.

title: Sotheby's Auction Results
key_finding: Realized prices for watches, art, antiques, and rare objects.
relevance: High-value comparable-sales reference for watches and antiques.

title: NAWCC Research Library
authors: National Association of Watch and Clock Collectors
key_finding: Horological research, serial databases, and condition-grading references for vintage timepieces.
relevance: Core reference for watch authentication, rarity, and condition.

title: Scott Catalogue
key_finding: Standard U.S. and world stamp catalogue values based on grade and scarcity.
relevance: Primary catalogue reference for philatelic valuations.

title: Stanley Gibbons Catalogues
key_finding: Commonwealth and world stamp catalogue values and market commentary.
relevance: Catalogue reference for British/Commonwealth stamp valuations.

title: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP)
key_finding: Ethics and reporting standards governing fair-market and replacement-cost appraisals.
relevance: Required framework for insurance and estate appraisal documentation.

title: International Society of Appraisers Member Resources
key_finding: Personal-property appraisal standards, glossary, and guide to ISA/USPAP-compliant reports.
relevance: Professional framework for antiques and personal-property valuation.
